people.imagined: A grave-cutter's squint; he knows where he'll be buried.
people.subject: The moment: he stands before a niche cut in a burial glacier and squints calmly at the viewer, the grave-cutter's squint exactly like his father's, a young man at peace with knowing where he will be buried. Face: a calm, squinting face of nineteen; a straight nose; thick black brows white at the tips with ice dust; a stubborn jaw; a closed mouth that gives nothing away; a faint rim of ice dust on the lower lashes. Hair: black, cut short. Body: sturdy and broad, planted square and still. Clothing: the simple graceful robe of an outer disciple, white silk with three crossed collars edged in pale ice blue, wide sleeves with a few small silver snowflakes at the cuffs, a pale frost-silk sash with a small white jade pendant, the shoulders clean and the hem dusted white with ice. Hands and objects: big hands holding a small mallet loosely at his side. Power: only a few motes of pale blue frost drift near his shoulders, very faint. Background: a clear blue niche with a smooth arch cut into the glacier wall, standing figures carved in ice receding beside him, and a little way off, blurred at the edge of the frame, his father with a chisel tucked behind his ear. Light: cold blue spirit-light glowing from within the ice, a soft silver rim light on his cheek and shoulder, mist hanging low. Expression: a still, level, honest squint, jaw set, mouth shut, stubbornly at peace, the look of a young man who has settled his account with death.

people.imagined: Reading ice from a skiff by its colour; palms blistered at the bow oar.
people.subject: The moment: she sits at the bow of a skiff in a sea of drifting floes, reading the ice by its colour with eyes gone pale as slate, then turns to look at the viewer. Face: a hard, lean, pale-eyed face of twenty-six; a thin straight nose; a thin mouth; wind-chapped cheeks; salt drying in pale lines along the jaw. Hair: black, cut short and wet at the ends. Body: wiry, braced at the bow with her weight forward. Clothing: a short, graceful white silk robe of an inner disciple with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, the sleeves bound back at the wrists with pale-blue cord, silver snowflake embroidery at the cuffs stiff with salt, a pale-blue frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant swinging at her hip. Hands and objects: both palms open on her knees, blistered at the heel from the bow oar, some of the blisters broken; a coil of wet rope and a boat-hook at her feet, the oar lying across the thwart. Power: a thin drift of cold water-qi mist curls off the sea around the bow, blue-white and faint. Background: a plain of grey-blue floes under a night sky, a cracked floe and a small net-boat far off, a stocky captain with a salt-white scar at the tiller, blurred. Light: cold silver moonlight from the upper left, spirit-light glinting along the ice edges, soft rim light on her wet hair. Expression: a hard, narrowed, impatient look, the pale eyes fixed on the colour of the floe, lips thin, a woman who has stared at the same cold sea too long and will go out on it again.

people.imagined: Hair that never dries; a pearl-seller's smile; a pearl in his cheek.
people.subject: The moment: he grins at the viewer with one cheek slightly bulging, a pearl-seller's smile with a pearl hidden in his cheek, both hands held open and empty to show he has nothing. Face: a wide-mouthed, damp, grinning face of twenty-three; bright, shrewd eyes crinkled with the grin; one cheek puffed where the pearl hides; a trace of nacre gleaming at the corner of his mouth. Hair: black and always wet, plastered to his forehead and dripping at the ends, drops falling steadily onto his collar. Body: broad and strong in the chest, a diver's build. Clothing: the graceful white silk robe of an outer disciple with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, dark with water, the wide sleeves rolled back to the elbow to show silver snowflake cuffs, a sash of pale frost silk with a small white jade pendant, and a net bag at the belt holding a few ordinary grey shells. Hands and objects: both hands open and empty in front of him, palms up, water running off the fingers. Background: a skin-boat of stitched hides bobbing at a pale shore, a deaf-eared diver beside it coughing and looking away, a grey-blue sea in drifting mist behind. Light: cold blue spirit-light on the water, silvery moonlight from the upper left, a bright pearly rim light on his wet hair and cheek. Expression: a wide, innocent, wickedly pleased grin, eyes crinkled and cheek bulging, a lad delighted by his own cleverness and quite sure no one will check.

people.imagined: Covering the page with her sleeve as she writes.
people.subject: The moment: she shields a page with her sleeve as she writes and looks up warily at the viewer. Face: a pale, cautious face of twenty-eight; quick dark eyes; a straight narrow nose; a thin mouth pressed tight. Hair: black, drawn into a neat bun pinned with a slim white jade pin, every strand smoothed back. Body: slim and narrow-shouldered, curved over the desk as if to hide it, her whole body turned a little away from the door. Clothing: a clean white silk inner-disciple robe with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, the long left sleeve, embroidered at the cuff with silver frost ferns, laid across the page like a screen, a pale-blue frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: her slender right hand holds a fine brush, its tip dark with ink; on the desk two sheets, one longer, with a line trimmed neatly from its edge by a small knife that rests beside it. Background: a copy room with shelves of tied rolls, a stool, a hanging lamp, and a tall quiet woman with abacus beads in her sleeve passing the door, blurred. Light: soft silver-blue lamp glow from the upper left, a thin glimmer of frost-light on the paper, a gentle rim light along her cheek. Expression: a wary, guarded glance, eyes lifted sideways over the sleeve, lips pressed thin, a careful woman working on something she does not want seen.

people.imagined: Knuckles still swollen from the fist that cost him the seat.
people.subject: The moment: knuckles still swollen from the fist that cost him his seat, he holds the bruised right hand up to the viewer, jaw set in anger, a bundle tied in cloth gripped in his left. Face: a square, young face of twenty-seven; brown, angry eyes; thick brows; a short nose; a split lip healing. Hair: black, short and rough. Body: broad, with a fighter's thick neck, shoulders squared, weight forward. Clothing: a white silk inner-disciple robe of three crossed collars edged in ice blue, pulled askew at one shoulder seam, the pale-blue frost-silk sash hanging loose with its white jade pendant dangling, silver snowflakes on the wide cuffs, the sign of a hearing he did not wait for. Hands and objects: the right hand raised, the knuckles skinned raw, red and purple and shiny, a dark crust at the first joint and a fresh yellow-green bruise spreading up the forearm; the left fist gripping the cloth bundle; a plain sword in a pale scabbard slung across his back, its hilt over his shoulder. Power: a few angry motes of cold blue qi flicker around the raised fist. Background: a harbour town of boats and a quay under mist, a skiff with a coast-blue lantern, a coast disciple with a drawl pulling at his arm, blurred. Light: pale blue-grey moonlight from the upper left, a hard silver rim light along his jaw. Expression: a hot, scowling, defiant glare, jaw clenched, brows low, a loyal man who still believes the blow was right.

people.imagined: Asleep on the bailing bucket, forearms like buckets.
people.subject: The moment: he dozes on an upturned bailing bucket in a skiff and wakes to see the viewer, the huge forearms folded on his knees. Face: a round, trusting, sleepy face of nineteen; a snub nose; small bright eyes just opening; a drool-line at the corner of the mouth; a single silver scale shining on one cheek. Hair: black and messy, flattened on one side from the bucket's rim where he slept. Body: huge-forearmed and thick-set, slumped comfortably. Clothing: the plain graceful white silk robe of an outer disciple with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a little stained at the front, the wide sleeves pushed up to the shoulder to show a hint of silver snowflake embroidery, a pale frost-silk sash with a small white jade pendant. Hands and objects: thick brown forearms folded on his knees, speckled with silver fish scales, a red ring on one where the bucket's rim pressed; beside him a basket of silver fish glinting, gulls eyeing it. Background: the skiff's brown sail flapping in mist, and on a pale dock his lean uncle with a whistle at his lips, blurred. Light: soft silver dawn light from the upper left, glittering on the water and the fish scales, a gentle rim light on his round cheek. Expression: a slow, blinking, good-natured look just waking, mouth a little open, eyes soft, a trusting lad who expects the world to be kind and to bring him lunch.

people.imagined: Salt-white lashes, a laugh that comes out as a cough; never seen ice outside a cup.
people.subject: The moment: she laughs and coughs at once, holding a cup in which a single piece of ice floats, and looks happily at the viewer; it is the first ice she has ever seen outside a cup. Face: a round, merry face of twenty-one; salt-white lashes catching the light like frost and making her eyes look pale; short dark brows; a wide, generous mouth; pink cheeks. Hair: black, in a thick plait held with a small white jade pin under a sand-coloured scarf. Body: sturdy and sun-brown, broad in hip and shoulder, the whole frame shaking with the laugh, her head tipped back. Clothing: a graceful white silk outer-disciple robe with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and silver snowflakes at the wide cuffs, a thin desert veil of pale gauze at the neck, a frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant; sandals with a rim of white salt crusted on them. Hands and objects: a cup of water held in both hands with one piece of ice floating in it, already melting and sparkling. Background: a sandy yard under a night sky with a well, a camel peering over a low wall, a saddle a dark shape behind her. Light: warm soft glow from the cup's ice, silvery moonlight from the upper left, sparkles on her white lashes. Expression: an open, delighted, breathless laugh, wide eyes fixed on the ice, honest to the point of rudeness and quick to give the cup to anyone who asks.

people.imagined: Rolling a coin over his knuckles in a tavern, mouth twisted bitter.
people.subject: The moment: in a tavern he rolls a coin across his knuckles and smirks bitterly at the viewer, having left the sect's whites behind. Face: a thin, sour, handsome face of twenty-three; narrow dark eyes; a straight nose; a mouth twisted to one side, with a faint line from nose to lip that deepens when he smirks. Hair: black, oiled and combed straight back from a high forehead, one lock fallen loose over the left eyebrow. Body: lean and long-limbed, slouched sideways in a carved wooden chair with one elbow on the table, deliberately careless. Clothing: in place of the sect's white he wears a loose, wide-sleeved oasis robe of fine brown silk with two crossed collars, belted with a sash of dyed red silk; the cut is still the cut of a cultivator's gown, graceful and long. Hands and objects: a bright copper coin walking over each knuckle in turn; a small celadon cup of wine at his other hand, barely touched; a slim sword in a dark scabbard leaning against the chair beside him, kept within reach. Background: a tavern of the oasis town of Hồi Lan with hanging lamps, rugs and men in headcloths listening to him, softly blurred. Light: warm low lantern glow from the upper left, a faint cool silver rim light, the coin glinting. Expression: a bitter, one-sided smirk, eyes narrow, brow arrogant, a man who nurses an old grievance patiently and enjoys the taste of it.

people.imagined: Inside her sealed cave on Băng Bích Nhai, 190 years into watching. She has just heard a step in the snow outside and turned only her head; her hair, never cut in two hundred years, is wrapped round her like a cloak and white with rime.
people.subject: The moment: in a cave of blue glacier ice, she sits very upright and turns only her head toward the viewer; the rest of her stays frozen still after hearing a step in the snow. Face: a small, fine-boned, ageless young face, pale as candle wax; very large, still, dark eyes with rime on the lashes; a straight small nose; thin pale lips; a calm without warmth; a faint blue tint at the temples. Hair: black, uncut for two hundred years, wound round and round her body like a cloak, hanging in heavy ropes to the floor, white with rime at the tips, the first thing the eye sees. Body: a small woman, sitting straight, shoulders narrow, hands mostly hidden. Clothing: the richest elder's dress of the sect: three layers of white silk with collars edged in ice blue and embroidered in silver frost ferns, a long over-robe of pale blue gauze drifting like mist around her, a frost-silk sash with a large white jade pendant, and a crown of white jade in her hair; her hair does most of the clothing. Hands and objects: a small black stone seal in one hand at her breast; at her side a leaning white silk banner with one frost lotus, no writing. Power: a deep still aura of white frost lies about her, ice crystals floating in the air in slow orbits, her breath a fine silver plume. Background: a cave of pale blue glacier plates bound with silver wire; one lamp. Light: cold blue spirit-light from the ice, a white glow rising from below, a soft silver rim light on her hair. Expression: eyes unblinking and lips barely parted, utterly still, as if holding a breath she has held for years.

people.imagined: A council hall at the seat; the one man who laughs there. He has just told a coast joke, his gourd of coast wine hanging from his wrist, and he laughs loud enough to rattle the pillars.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a long table in a white-pillared hall, he throws back his head in a booming laugh, then turns his big weathered face to the viewer, grinning, having just told a coast joke. Face: a broad, square, deeply weathered face of fifty; a wide laughing mouth; thick crows'-feet; small bright blue eyes, shrewd under heavy brows; a big red-brown nose; a short grey-streaked beard. Hair: black shot with grey, tied in a plain topknot under a small silver crown. Body: huge, broad, with thick fisher's forearms and big hands, a red-knuckled scarred left thumb. Clothing: a plain white elder's robe of fine silk with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a long pale-blue gauze over-robe thrown open, coast-blue lining at the cuffs under silver snowflake borders, a frost-silk elder's sash with a white jade pendant; he has kept his old dark glossy sealskin coat hanging open over the silk. Hands and objects: a fisher's wine gourd on a rope sling in his right hand held up at shoulder height, the sling wound round his wrist, wine slopping as he laughs; at his elbow a broad ice-cutter's blade reforged into a sword in a plain black scabbard, its hilt wrapped in pale grey sharkskin. Power: a heavy cold-blue current of water-qi rolls faintly around his shoulders like a tide, the cups on the table quivering. Background: pale pillars of the hall rising in cold ranks, white-robed councillors stiff and pained, one covering his ears, a pale woman at the head of the table with the faintest smile, all softly blurred. Light: warm light on his face against the cool blue of the room, a silver rim light on the gauze. Expression: a hearty, open grin with bright eyes, the grin of a man who means every joke and every vote.

people.imagined: Deep in the Array under the seat she walks by touch from node to node; thin and stooped, hands cold, a frost-silk sash knotted the old way; the pine tea smell clings to her.
people.subject: The moment: in a blue-lit tunnel she presses a carved locust-wood seal to a glowing stone node and turns her head to the viewer with a flicker of worry. Face: a thin, honest, deeply lined face of sixty-five by appearance; sunken cheeks, high cheekbones; sharp pale grey eyes; a long nose; thin colourless lips set in anxiety; skin like old paper; her breath shows as a thin cloud. Hair: white, thin, drawn into a low bun fixed with a plain locust-wood pin and a small silver comb. Body: thin, stooped and narrow, her hands bluish with cold. Clothing: an elder's robe of white silk with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a pale-blue gauze over-robe drifting round her like mist, silver frost-fern borders on the wide sleeves, a frost-silk sash knotted in the old-fashioned way with a white jade pendant; soft grey woollen mittens show under the cuffs; a round locust-wood shield rides on her back like a lid, and at her hip a disc of polished lake ice in a silver rim glints like a small moon. Hands and objects: in her right hand the round locust-wood seal, dark red-brown and worn smooth, a ring of 108 tiny hollows carved round its face; the left laid on a blue stone node; a small clay cup of pine tea forgotten and cold on a ledge beside her. Power: the node glows a faint steady blue and brightens a shade as she presses the seal. Background: a low stone tunnel with a ring of faint blue lights, its walls scratched with chalk tallies. Light: cold blue spirit-light from the stone, from below and the left, a silver rim light on her white hair. Expression: a wary, anxious frown, eyes bright and truthful, a plain-spoken woman who cannot hide that she is running short of time.

people.imagined: Evening, the anniversary of the fall of Cô Thành. He sits alone with a brush and a white sword on his knees, and he has just written his yearly poem; the plum-blossom scar on his left hand shows.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on the anniversary of a lost fortress he sits upright with a white sword lying across his knees and looks up from a sheet of paper toward the viewer, brush in hand, having just written his yearly poem. Face: a long, lean, ascetic old face of sixty by appearance; high forehead; deep lines; sharp brown eyes burning with a low steady fire; a thin straight nose; thin lips pressed together; a short grey beard. Hair: white, long, tied in a high topknot with a white-jade pin. Body: lean, straight and tall, thin-wristed. Clothing: a plum-white silk sword robe with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a faint plum-blossom pattern woven into the cloth, a pale-blue gauze over-robe, a frost-silk elder's sash with a white jade pendant; over one shoulder a folded cape of plum-red silk, scorched at one corner. Hands and objects: on the back of his left hand a perfect five-petalled plum-blossom scar in pale shiny skin; in the right hand a brush; across his lap a sword of pale blade the colour of milk-glass with a faint pink glow along its edge; a poem sheet on the low desk blank but for a few wet strokes. Power: a thin pink glow of sword qi hangs along the blade and a few pale plum petals drift in the still air above it. Background: a bare room with one lamp and a window onto grey dusk, falling snow and a single bare plum branch with one bud. Light: low silver-blue dusk light from the window at the upper left, a faint pink on the blade, a soft rim light on his white hair. Expression: a long, patient mourning, the eyes steady and fierce, the mouth tight, a man who has grieved for four hundred years and has not forgiven.

people.imagined: On the practice floor at the Vessel Hall, she has just finished a form with a sword so clear it looks glazed glass; she counts the five frost stars on her ring before a duel.
people.subject: The moment: on the white practice floor she stands with her glass-clear sword raised before her face and looks past the blade at the viewer, perfectly composed after finishing a form. Face: a beautiful, cold, exact face of thirty; a high clear brow; long almond eyes the colour of lake ice; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a firm closed mouth with pale rose lips; skin flawless as porcelain; a gaze unwavering and without warmth. Hair: black with a blue sheen, in a high smooth knot with a pale ice hairpin and a thin silver crown. Body: tall, slender and straight, absolutely balanced. Clothing: the richest dress the sect gives a chief disciple: layered white silk of the finest weave with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a long over-robe of translucent pale-blue gauze trailing behind her, wide sleeves embroidered with silver snowflakes and brushed with faint frost-ink pattern, a frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: a sword of clear glassy ice-like steel held upright, so clear that the white hall shows through it bent and small, the edge a bright line; on her left hand a ring of five tiny white frost stars set in ice, her thumb resting on the fifth. Power: a visible pale blue aura of cold qi shapes itself about her in fine crystal lines, ice motes turning slowly around the blade. Background: a white hall of pillars, a faint blue ring inlaid in a polished floor, a row of younger disciples in white watching with awe, blurred. Light: cold clear moonlight from the upper left, the blade's edge glittering, a crisp silver rim light on her shoulder. Expression: a cool, level, proud stare, chin a little raised, a woman wholly absorbed in her own exactness and unaware of how it looks.

people.imagined: At a go board at the Desert Pavilion, she smiles in public as the only elder who does; sand lies in the folds of her white robe.
people.subject: The moment: she sits at a go board with a white stone between two fingers and smiles warmly at the viewer. Face: a sun-browned, round, kind-sharp face of fifty; laugh lines; smiling dark eyes that are quick and weigh the viewer like a stone; full lips; a small straight nose. Hair: brown with grey, in a thick plaited coil held with a white jade pin and a sand-coloured scarf. Body: plump, comfortable and relaxed. Clothing: an elder's robe of white silk with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a pale-blue gauze over-robe drifting from her shoulders, silver snowflake borders on the wide sleeves, a frost-silk elder's sash with a white jade pendant, a light desert shawl of pale gauze; sand lies in a pale fan in the folds of her lap and a few grains cling to her sleeve. Hands and objects: a white go stone held between two fingers, broad brown hands with short nails and a thin silver ring; a plain wooden go board before her with an unfinished scatter of black and white stones, no marks but the lines; a bowl of black stones at her elbow and a small porcelain cup of green tea. Power: a few soft motes of cool blue qi and a trace of desert sand-glitter drift near her hands. Background: a sunlit adobe room with a carved wooden screen, a camel-hair rug in red and cream, a window showing a date palm. Light: warm golden light from the upper left on her round brown face making the laugh lines golden, a faint cool silver rim along the gauze. Expression: an easy, open smile, bright eyes quietly measuring, a woman who is friendly because it works and shrewd because it pays.

people.imagined: On the vein ridge in a rising storm, a lightning lash scar from his shoulder to his wrist shows; his left arm twitches.
people.subject: The moment: on a ridge in a rising storm he stands with a copper rod beside him and looks calmly at the viewer, the left sleeve pushed up to show a lightning scar from shoulder to wrist, the left arm trembling slightly. Face: a quiet, lined, calm face of fifty-five; deep-set, steady eyes; a short grey-streaked beard. Hair: grey-black, tied back in a topknot with a silver pin. Body: tall and solid, planted still against the wind. Clothing: a white elder's robe of fine silk with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and a pale-blue gauze over-robe whipping in the wind, a frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant, the left sleeve pushed up to the shoulder, copper-wire cuffs at both wrists. Hands and objects: the white branching lightning scar, a pale fern pattern on tanned skin, running from shoulder to wrist in the foreground; the left hand shaking in a fine tremor that he holds still with the right on a short copper rod whose tip is blackened. Power: thin blue-white threads of lightning qi crawl over the copper wire at his wrist and up the rod, with a cold blue aura at the edge of his shoulders. Background: a ridge of snow streaked with black rocks, a line of copper rods against a violet-black storm sky, a blue flash briefly lighting the clouds. Light: cold storm light from the upper left, a blue flicker on the scarred arm, a silver rim light along his jaw. Expression: a calm, quiet, accepting look, the eyes steady and the mouth at ease, a man who loves the thing that hurts him.

people.imagined: With a white sable across her shoulders so still it is taken for a fur, and a frost wolf at her heel; wiry and wind-burned, smelling of hide and snow.
people.subject: The moment: she strides across the snow with a white sable draped on her shoulders and a frost wolf at her hip, glancing back at the viewer with a quick, bright look. Face: a wiry, wind-burned, weathered face of fifty; bright, sharp eyes the colour of tea; a firm chin; a wide mouth with chapped lips. Hair: black and grey, in a tight braid bound with a silver cord and a white jade bead. Body: lean and tough, the stride quick and the glance back impatient. Clothing: an elder's riding robe of white silk with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a pale-blue gauze over-robe tied back for the ride, a slim harness of silver rings across the chest for the beasts' leads, a frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant, tall fur-trimmed boots; a white sable draped over the shoulders so still that it is taken for a fur, one black bead eye showing. Hands and objects: one hand resting on the head of a big grey-white wolf with a black stripe down its spine and frost in its ruff, amber eyes watching the viewer. Power: a faint cold-blue shimmer of qi hangs about her and the wolf together, a few ice motes riding the air between them. Background: a vast snowfield under a moonlit pale sky with a line of footprints and a few distant white beasts. Light: cold silver moonlight from the upper left, a bright rim light on the wolf's ruff and her braid. Expression: a quick, bright, impatient glance with a hint of warmth in the wide mouth, a woman who prefers animals to speeches and is kind without saying so.

people.imagined: At court he bows exactly as deep as the listener's rank and never deeper; there is ink on his cuff.
people.subject: The moment: he makes a precise, shallow bow toward the viewer and straightens, smiling softly. Face: a neat, smooth, pleasant face of fifty; soft brown eyes; a small trimmed moustache; a gentle, slightly rehearsed smile. Hair: black with grey, in a neat scholar's knot pinned with a lacquered pin and a silver ring. Body: medium height, upright and well kept. Clothing: an envoy's robe of the finest white silk with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a pale-blue gauze over-robe hanging in perfect folds, silver snowflake borders on the wide sleeves, a pale-blue frost-silk sash tied in a flat knot with a white jade pendant; on his right cuff a small black ink stain the size of a coin shows plainly against the white. Hands and objects: hands folded in the sleeves; a thin brush case at the sash and a rolled map-case under the left arm; he bows exactly as deep as the viewer's rank and no deeper; every detail of him is tidy, except the ink. Power: a faint cool shimmer of qi lies on his sleeves like frost on glass, barely visible. Background: a court gallery of carved wood and paper screens running back, a few envoys in other colours waiting, soft and indistinct. Light: soft silvery light from the upper left, a pale rim light along his shoulder. Expression: a gentle, composed smile with calm eyes, the practised charm of a man who always knows what to say and rarely says all of it.

people.imagined: At the Hàn Giao Chử furnace, red-cheeked and sweating in the cold, his robe hanging open; he is counting dice in his palm.
people.subject: The moment: he stands by a roaring red furnace with his robe hanging open, rattling a pair of bone dice in a cupped palm, and grins at the viewer, red-cheeked and sweating in the cold. Face: a flushed, sweating, round face of forty-five; bright, greedy eyes; a bold grin; red cheeks shining with sweat. Hair: black with grey, tied back with a copper pin, loose strands stuck to the forehead, sweat running into the grey. Body: stout and hot-blooded, chest heaving, feet apart in the furnace glow. Clothing: unlike the sect's white, a robe of rich rust-red silk with three crossed collars, worn open to the waist over a damp inner shirt, wide sleeves with embroidered gold flames at the cuffs, the only warm colour in the Pavilion; a sash of orange silk hung with a ring of small keys, a pouch of pills and a jade pendant. Hands and objects: a pair of bone dice rattled in one cupped hand, the thick fingers stained orange and brown with furnace work and one nail black; a long ladle in the other hand. Power: sparks and orange motes of fire qi drift up around his shoulders, and the air above his head shimmers with heat. Background: the furnace's red mouth roaring behind him, a row of clay pots on a shelf, a cold stone yard with a white fence and beyond it the pale slope of the frozen mere. Light: red furnace glow from the lower left against blue snow-light, a hot rim light along his cheek. Expression: a bold, greedy, sweaty grin with the eyes fixed on the dice, a man who works hard at the furnace and gambles harder.

people.imagined: In summer heat she wears the winter robe her name means; she stands in a stance copied from her master, perfectly still for a full day.
people.subject: The moment: in summer heat she stands in the winter robe her name means, in a stance copied from her master, perfectly still for a full day, eyes level, meeting the viewer's gaze without moving. Face: a grave, pale, serious young face of twenty-four; level dark eyes; fine straight brows; a closed mouth; a single bead of sweat at the temple though she does not blink. Hair: black, long and straight, tied low with a white silk ribbon and a small jade clasp. Body: slender, tall and absolutely still. Clothing: a heavy winter robe of undyed white spirit silk with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a high collar and long sleeves with a faint quilted texture, silver frost-fern embroidery down the wide cuffs, worn in the heat of summer, with a pale-blue frost-silk sash and a small frost seal of white jade at the sash. Hands and objects: a plain narrow ice-blue sword held point down in both hands, the blade at rest. Power: a light frost-mist of cold qi curls from the sleeves and hem, the only cool air in the room. Background: a white hall whose wooden floor catches a bright block of summer sun from a window. Light: cold silver light on her from the upper left, the warm summer sun on the floor with her shadow lying unmoving across it as she has stood a whole day. Expression: a calm, closed, stubborn stillness, eyes unblinking, mouth shut, a woman who would rather stand in the heat until she drops than move first.

people.imagined: In the corridor, her frost leaves a faint grey stain where it melts; her black eyes do not reflect the lamps.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim corridor she looks at the viewer with black eyes that reflect nothing, holding a needle of black-cored ice between two fingers. Face: a small, pale, delicate face of twenty-six; large pure black eyes that take in the lamp and give back nothing, with no highlight in them; thin dark brows; a small mouth with a faint smile. Hair: black, in a high bun pinned with a plain ice needle and a slim silver ornament. Body: small and light, standing very straight. Clothing: a graceful white silk inner-disciple robe of three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a pale-blue gauze overlayer, silver snowflake embroidery at the wide cuffs, a faint grey frost-stain along the left cuff where something melted, a frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: the needle, a thin crystal with a dark thread at its heart, between two fingers, a faint grey stain spreading on the ice where her fingertips touch it like breath on glass; at the sash a small black-backed mirror that shows a white face on its front and none behind. Power: a soft pale aura of cold lies around her, and in it a few motes of deep shadow drift unseen unless one looks, absorbing the light rather than shining. Background: a dim corridor of white stone with lamp-niches that burn without reflecting in her eyes. Light: soft silver lamp light from the upper left, a thin rim light on her cheek, her eyes remaining dark. Expression: a faint, patient, secret smile with a level and unreflecting gaze, someone quietly concealing a purpose and in no hurry to reveal it.

people.imagined: On the lake ice sitting the old Hàn Giang way, singing a fisherman's song under his breath, badly.
people.subject: The moment: he sits cross-legged on the lake ice in the old river way with his back straight, singing a fisherman's song under his breath, badly, an ice gourd in his hand, then grins at the viewer. Face: a tall, easy, sunburnt young face of twenty-four; a wide goofy grin; warm brown eyes; a crooked nose; a thin line of beard. Hair: black, tied back with a silver cord. Body: tall and long-limbed, sitting upright as an old man of the river would. Clothing: a white silk robe of an inner disciple with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, wide sleeves with silver snowflake cuffs spread on the ice, a pale-blue frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: an old gourd, dark with handling and bound at the neck with a thin cord, with a tiny stick figure of a lone fisher with a rod scratched on its side; across his knees a fisher's sword in a plain scabbard, an ice-cutter's blade ground down. Power: faint pale-blue mist curls up from the ice around him and a few motes of frost circle the gourd. Background: the frozen river stretching flat and white at night to a line of low cottages with smoke rising, under a sky of soft stars. Light: clear silver moonlight from the upper left, a bright rim light on his hair and the gourd. Expression: a wide, open, goofy grin mid-song, eyes warm and unselfconscious, a brave honest man who knows he is out of tune and does not care.

people.imagined: Copying her master's manual in red ink; her fingers are stained red; a duel in mind.
people.subject: The moment: she looks up from copying her master's manual in red ink with a stare like a drawn blade, a duel already in mind. Face: a sharp-featured, handsome, hard face of thirty-two; fierce dark eyes; thin straight brows; a clean jaw; a thin mouth; a smear of red ink on one cheek. Hair: black, drawn up into a tight topknot held by a plain white jade pin, not a loose strand anywhere. Body: athletic and upright, straight-backed and square-shouldered like a guard captain's daughter. Clothing: a white silk sword robe with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a plum-red band embroidered at the cuffs with silver plum blossoms, a pale-blue frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: fingertips stained red with ink; a brush in one hand; her white-hilted sword lying across the desk beside the brush and a small stone of red ink. Power: a pale cold glow of sword qi lies along the sheathed blade and a few faint plum petals drift near it. Background: a plum sword hall, bare and bright, with a wall of racked swords and one empty peg for a red blade. Light: clear silver moonlight from the upper left, hard on her cheekbones and glinting on the red of the ink. Expression: a fierce, cold, unblinking glare, jaw clenched, thin mouth set, a woman who has been wronged and is counting how she will answer it.

people.imagined: A hostage in the Vessel Hall, a sabre scar and a ready laugh; the only warm-coloured robe.
people.subject: The moment: sprawled in a seat in the pale hall, he laughs and raises a drinking cup to the viewer, a white go stone held between the fingers of the other hand. Face: a handsome, brown face of twenty-eight, a sabre scar from cheekbone to jaw whitened with age, strong teeth, warm eyes that watch everything. Hair: black, long, tied back with a red silk cord and a small gold clasp. Body: broad and relaxed. Clothing: unlike the sect's white, a rich desert-red silk robe of three crossed collars with a gold-stitched border, wide sleeves embroidered with gold sun-and-dune patterns, a dark silk sash with a jade pendant, the only warm colour in the hall, a little dusty at the hem. Hands and objects: the cup lifted high, the stone turning between his fingers. Power: a few warm orange sparks and motes of dusky light drift about his shoulders, faint. Background: the pale cold hall of the Vessel Hall, white-robed disciples glancing at him with curiosity, and a small woman with black eyes standing apart, whose gaze he seeks, all softly blurred; he has watched everything for seventy-nine years and smiles anyway. Light: cool silver moonlight from the upper left with a warm gleam on his cup and a golden rim light on his cheek. Expression: a ready, wide, gregarious laugh with eyes that do not laugh quite as much as the mouth, a hostage who has decided to be charming and has not decided to forgive.

people.imagined: A round, kind face with frostbitten earlobes, on a solstice night on the mere.
people.subject: The moment: on a solstice night she sits on a folded blanket on the frozen mere beside a paper lantern and looks warmly at the viewer, her breath smoking, with the patient attention of a woman who has remembered every one who walked back. Face: a round, kind face of fifty; the earlobes red, thickened and frostbitten from a hundred solstice nights of cold; soft dark eyes; a gentle, tired smile. Hair: grey, in a low bun with a silver pin. Body: round and settled, sitting with her knees under the blanket. Clothing: a white silk robe of three crossed collars edged in ice blue, silver snowflake embroidery at the wide cuffs, a pale-blue frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant, and over it a thick grey wool shawl. Hands and objects: a paper lantern at her side; a basket of warm stones and a flask of hot ginger water; her short thick hands chapped from the cold. Power: a soft ring of cold blue qi lies on the ice around her blanket, and a few motes of frost-light glitter in the lantern's glow. Background: the vast frozen lake dark under stars, small figures in white sitting in rows on the ice, each with a lantern. Light: warm lantern glow from below against cold blue night, a silver rim light on her grey hair. Expression: a patient, tender, steady smile with soft eyes, the face of a woman who never loses count of the people in her care and gives each of them the same unhurried look.

people.imagined: Brown, freckled, wrapped in three borrowed furs on the frozen mere, talking to a pot of reed.
people.subject: The moment: she looks out of a mound of furs with a hopeful, stubborn face, a small reed pot in her hands, on the frozen mere with her breath smoking. Face: a brown, freckled, warm face of twenty-one; wide hopeful dark eyes; a nose red with cold; round cheeks and a wobbling stubborn smile; freckled by the oasis sun. Hair: black braids that stick out under a fur hat too big for her. Body: small and bundled. Clothing: beneath the furs she wears the white silk robe of an outer disciple with three crossed collars edged in ice blue and silver snowflake cuffs, her pale-blue sash and jade pendant just visible; piled to her ears are three borrowed furs: a grey wolf pelt, a brown goatskin and a white sable collar, each from a different friend. Hands and objects: a small clay pot holding one oasis reed, a single slender green stem with two leaves, fresh and bright against the white, held in both hands as if it were a bird; a lantern at her side. Power: a very faint shimmer of pale green life-light touches the reed's leaves. Background: the frozen lake of dusk, and behind her a round-faced, kind woman nodding. Light: a soft lantern glow and a cold blue dusk from the upper left, a silver rim light on the fur. Expression: a stubborn, hopeful, humble look, lips pressed to keep the smile from wobbling, a girl who has failed twice and means to try a third time.

people.imagined: Heavy harbour anklets she refuses to take off.
people.subject: The moment: in a sunny sandstone yard she lifts her hem a little to show a heavy silver anklet engraved with small waves, one of a pair she refuses to take off, and smiles warmly at the viewer. Face: a warm, calm, round face of twenty-three; large, dark, gentle eyes; full lips in a warm, unhurried smile. Hair: black, in a plait threaded with bright beads of red and green glass and a white jade pin. Body: sturdy and easy, standing with her weight settled, a small bronze bell chiming at her ankle with each breath she shifts. Clothing: a white silk inner-disciple robe with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, silver snowflake embroidery at the wide cuffs, a pale-blue frost-silk sash tied the harbour way with a white jade pendant, small bronze bells at the hem; bare brown feet with the toenails painted pale rose. Hands and objects: the hem held between finger and thumb to show the pair of heavy silver anklets, which jingle when she walks. Background: a sunny sandstone yard, a camel kneeling beside a trough, a stout woman turning toward her in a lifted greeting. Light: warm bright evening light from the upper left, glinting on the silver, with a soft cool rim light on her shoulder. Expression: a gentle, unhurried, comfortable smile with soft eyes, a girl from the harbour who is at last at home and sure of being welcome.

people.imagined: Reed cuts on both hands, laughing at the well.
people.subject: The moment: at a stone well beside a bed of green oasis reeds she laughs out loud with her head thrown back and holds up both hands to show their palms and fingers criss-crossed with small red reed cuts. Face: a round, happy face of eighteen; bright brown eyes screwed up with laughter; a snub nose; a wide mouth; a smear of green reed-juice across the chin. Hair: brown, tied in a loose knot with a strip of reed and a white jade pin. Body: small and quick, bare toes gripping the damp stone beside the well. Clothing: a graceful white silk outer-disciple robe with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, silver snowflakes at the cuffs, a pale-blue sash with a small white jade pendant, green stains at the sleeves from reed juice, the hem tucked up. Hands and objects: both hands raised, cut by the reeds; a clay watering pot at her feet. Background: the well and the green reeds growing in its overflow, her aunt with a dried lily in her braid drawing a bucket behind her, pale golden sand beyond. Light: warm golden light of a sunlit afternoon from the upper left, a soft rim light on her hair. Expression: a loud, uncontainable, delighted laugh, eyes shut tight and the whole face open, a girl who cannot hold a laugh in and would share a cut finger as readily as a joke.

people.imagined: Camel dust in his eyebrows, training with a wooden sword.
people.subject: The moment: in a camel yard he swings a wooden practice sword with a grunt and glances at the viewer, dust in his eyebrows. Face: a blunt, brave face of twenty-six; a heavy jaw; small dark eyes; a broad nose; a faint clean line of sweat cutting through the dust on his temple. Hair: black, cropped close to the scalp and sandy with dust, a few dark curls stuck damp to the forehead. Body: broad and thick-armed, sunburnt arms swelling with the swing, a stance that says he has no intention of ever sitting on a frozen lake. Clothing: a short riding robe of white silk with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, silver snowflakes at the cuffs, the hem grey with dust to the knee, tied with a pale-blue sash and a leather belt with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: a wooden sword notched along the edge by a hundred drills, gripped in both big hands, knuckles pale, wrists thick as a post. Power: a faint glimmer of metal-bright qi runs along the wooden blade as it cuts the air. Background: a ring of trodden sand with wooden posts, a water barrel and a row of kneeling camels, a bow-legged teacher with a missing tooth watching, a haze of dust rising. Light: bright, hard light from the upper left, a gold-white rim light on his shoulder through the dust. Expression: a blunt, stubborn, eager look, jaw set and eyes narrowed with glee at the fight, a brave young man who loves a drill the way others love a feast.

people.imagined: Straw in her braid and a horse's patient stare.
people.subject: The moment: she stands holding a horse's rope with straw in her braid, her patient face mirroring the horse's patient stare, as it nuzzles her shoulder. Face: a calm, plain, brown face of nineteen; calm dark eyes; a broad nose; a wide, quiet mouth; the bay's breath puffing warm at her neck as she stands unmoving. Hair: brown, in one long braid threaded with straw. Body: sturdy and broad in the hip, weight settled evenly on both feet, standing very still as one does beside a horse that startles easily, shoulders loose. Clothing: a mortal servant's tunic of plain undyed cotton, simple, clean and belted with a cord, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a narrow pale-blue edging at the collar in the sect's colour; old leather gloves tucked in at the waist. Hands and objects: the rope held loosely in one hand; the other resting on the horse's cheek; a dusty bay horse with a white star. Background: a low mud-brick stable with an open door and a dim hayloft above, a bucket and a pitchfork leaning against the wall. Light: the long golden light of late afternoon from the upper left, a soft rim light on the horse's mane and her braid. Expression: a patient, calm, unassuming look, eyes steady and mouth quiet, a girl who has no Water at all and came anyway, says she does not count, and is simply glad to be among horses.

people.imagined: Tending the furnace with his eyebrows singed off, unable to stand still.
people.subject: The moment: he bounces on his toes by a roaring furnace and grins, one heel tapping, holding an iron poker in both hands like a spear. Face: a bright, eager, round face of twenty-one with no eyebrows, the brow bare where they were singed off once and never regrew, giving him a permanently startled look; bright eyes and a wide grin lit orange. Hair: black, spiky and tufted. Body: wiry and restless, unable to stand still, himself in a pool of warm red light with the snow outside blue behind him. Clothing: a clean, plain furnace-boy's tunic of undyed cotton with a pale-blue edge at the collar, a leather apron scorched at the hem with a patch of ash on the chest, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a cord belt with a small white stone bead; he is a servant and wears nothing finer. Hands and objects: an iron poker held across the body in both hands; a smear of ash on one forearm. Power: a few small orange sparks of fire qi rise from the coals and cling to his hair. Background: the furnace behind him roaring, a pile of charcoal sacks beside it, a thin quiet man in a leather apron feeding wood, blue snow beyond the doorway. Light: red furnace glow from below, cold blue light at the doorway, a hot rim light on his cheek. Expression: an excited, startled-looking, wide grin with the bare brow lifted, a talkative lad who is delighted by fire and by everyone who comes near it.

people.imagined: Hands bleached white and wrinkled to the wrist; she washes four hundred robes in warmed water.
people.subject: The moment: she lifts both white, wrinkled hands from a tub of steaming water and looks tiredly at the viewer, the hands bleached and wrinkled to the wrist like a drowned woman's; she has found a Wood breath of her own in the steam. Face: a patient, thin, tired face of forty; gentle dark eyes ringed with shadow; a small mouth; a faint flush of steam at the cheekbones. Hair: brown, tied up under a plain cloth with damp wisps curling at the temples. Body: thin and slightly bent from the tub, shoulders rounded forward, weight on one hip, as one stands after bending over water for hours. Clothing: a mortal servant's tunic of plain undyed cotton, clean and dark with damp at sleeves and lap, a pale-blue edging at the collar, a simple apron, forearms bare and red. Hands and objects: both hands raised in the foreground, bleached white and wrinkled to the wrists, water running from the fingertips. Power: in the rising steam a few faint green motes of wood qi gather above her palms, soft and shy. Background: a washing yard with lines of white silk robes hanging in rows like pale ghosts, steam rising from tubs, a thin young man sweeping, all blurred. Light: bright pale morning spirit-light through the steam from the upper left, a soft silver rim light on her cloth and cheek. Expression: a tired, gentle, uncomplaining look, eyes soft and mouth at rest, a woman humble and kind who has long since stopped expecting thanks.

people.imagined: His palms are always warm and steam in the winter air.
people.subject: The moment: he holds out both steaming hands to the viewer and smiles; he was sent up from the fishing village at ten to carry water and it turned out he could warm it with his hands. Face: a trusting, rosy, round-cheeked boy's face of seventeen; bright brown eyes; a wide, open smile; cheeks pink from the warmth of his own hands. Hair: black, cut short and neat. Body: slight and narrow-shouldered, standing eagerly forward. Clothing: a servant's tunic of plain undyed white cotton, clean and belted with a cord, sleeves rolled up, a pale-blue edging at the collar, a grey cloth apron. Hands and objects: both palms red and steaming in thin curls in the cold air, held out toward the viewer; a thin curl of steam also rising from the sleeve ends. Power: a soft golden-white warmth glows faintly in his palms and a few pale blue motes of water qi turn to steam above them. Background: a kitchen with a row of cauldrons, a copper kettle on a stone ledge beside him, a round-shouldered tea master pouring for someone he fancies, and a girl with a tray, softly blurred. Light: warm kitchen light from the upper left with steam catching it, a pale silver rim light on his cheek. Expression: a trusting, hopeful, wide-open smile with bright eyes, a diligent boy who is shyly proud of the one strange gift he has and eager to be of use.

people.imagined: A perfectly still face with one tiny line between the brows she is proud of; she has turned her back on a weeping friend.
people.subject: The moment: she has just turned her back on a friend who wept at the lake, and looks back over her shoulder at the viewer with no expression at all. Face: a smooth, pale face of eighteen; cool light eyes; a straight nose; a small closed mouth; a single tiny line between the brows that she is proud of. Hair: black, drawn into a neat bun pinned with a white jade pin, smooth and exact, not a single hair out of line. Body: slim and upright, shoulders squared and spine straight, the neck turned just far enough to look back and the rest of her turned decisively away. Clothing: a faultlessly pressed white silk inner-disciple robe with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, narrow sleeves with silver snowflake cuffs, a pale-blue frost-silk sash with a white jade pendant. Hands and objects: slim hands folded before her, not a finger out of place; a slim white-scabbarded sword hangs at her sash, its hilt wrapped in pale blue silk. Power: a thin ring of pale frost-light lies on the floor around her feet and a few ice motes hang motionless in the air. Background: the white hall of the Pavilion, a weeping girl with red eyes small and blurred at the edge of the frame. Light: cold, even silver light from the upper left, a crisp rim light along her neck. Expression: a perfectly still, cool, smooth face with a tiny line between the brows and no feeling in the eyes, a girl who is taking the Ice Heart too literally and is proud of how well she does it.

people.imagined: Grinding red ink, cuffs stained red, back hunched.
people.subject: The moment: he grinds a stick of red ink on a dark stone slab and looks up; he has learned the forms from the margins. Face: a patient, mild, honest young face of twenty-five; brown eyes; a snub nose; an ink-smudged cheek. Hair: black, tied back with a plain cloth and a white jade pin, a few stray strands falling over a brow where he has pushed it back with an inky wrist. Body: hunched, the back rounded from years of grinding, sitting low on a stool with elbows close, forearms moving in a slow, practised circle. Clothing: a clean white silk inner-disciple robe with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a pale-blue sash with a white jade pendant, the wide cuffs embroidered with silver snowflakes and stained red to the elbow. Hands and objects: slender fingers stained red under the nails, working the ink-stick on the stone; beside him a brush-rest and a small porcelain water-dropper. Power: a faint pale glow of cold sword qi gathers in the red ink as it thickens, hardly visible. Background: a quiet hall with a long table of copied leaves of the manual drying under pebble weights, a woman with a red thumbnail writing at the end of it, and a plain wooden sword hanging on the wall. Light: soft warm lamp light from the upper left, a red tint on the ink, a pale silver rim light on his hair. Expression: a mild, honest, patient look just lifted from his work, eyes calm and mouth soft, a diligent man who asks nothing and does the task before him.

people.imagined: Owl feathers behind one ear, unblinking pale eyes.
people.subject: The moment: he stares unblinking at the viewer with a small white sable curled in the crook of his arm; he was raised by snow-owl trappers on the tundra and talks more to sables than to people. Face: a pale, still, lean face of twenty-two; pale unblinking eyes; a thin straight nose; a quiet mouth. Hair: dark, long and tied back, with two owl feathers, brown and cream barred, tucked behind one ear. Body: lean and tall, as still as a post, shoulders narrow and arms held close, with the patience of a man who has waited in snow for animals to come to him. Clothing: a white silk riding robe of an inner disciple with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, silver snowflakes at the wide cuffs, a pale-blue sash with a white jade pendant and a slim silver harness across the chest. Hands and objects: the small white sable curled in the crook of one arm, stroked by two fingers of the other hand. Power: a few motes of cold blue qi drift between him and the sable, and the sable's fur holds a faint frost glitter. Background: a vast, almost empty white tundra under a pale moonlit sky, and at its edge a big white-maned ice wolf with a lazy rider waiting, blurred. Light: cold, bright silver moonlight from the upper left, a thin rim light on the feathers and the sable's fur. Expression: a pale, steady, unblinking gaze and a mouth at rest, a quiet young man who is brave without showing it and has little to say to anyone who is not furred.

people.imagined: Hair standing on end near the rods, placing each foot as if testing it.
people.subject: The moment: on the ridge he stands carefully with his hair on end, placing each foot as if testing it, and looks warily at the viewer; he has twice been knocked flat. Face: a wary, thin face of twenty-six; dark eyes ringed with sleeplessness; a pinched mouth; a long nose. Hair: black, every strand lifted straight from the scalp like the bristles of a brush, the ends faintly glowing blue where the air crackles. Body: thin and long-limbed, caught mid-stride on the balls of his feet with his weight held back, shoulders drawn up around his ears as if the sky might fall. Clothing: a white silk inner-disciple robe with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, a pale-blue sash with a white jade pendant, silver snowflake cuffs wound with copper wire. Hands and objects: a copper rod taller than himself held upright in one hand, with an oiled-cloth wrap round the grip. Power: small blue sparks run along the copper wire at his cuffs and the rod's tip, and the air around him prickles with faint violet light. Background: the ridge crowded with copper rods against a black-violet sky with a branching blue fork of lightning, and a woman with her head tilted listening, blurred. Light: flat cold light from the upper left with a blue flicker, a bright electric rim light on his lifted hair. Expression: a wary, tense, watchful look, eyes wide and mouth pinched, a careful man who has learned what the sky can do.

people.imagined: Dark circles under her eyes; the lamp never trembles.
people.subject: The moment: in a stone tunnel under the seat she holds a steady cold-light lamp, a small pale glass globe giving a blue-white glow that never trembles in her hand, and looks tiredly at the viewer, having noticed the damp sleeves. Face: a tired, careful face of twenty-four with dark circles under large, grave eyes; a straight small nose; a patient mouth. Hair: black, in a bun pinned with a plain white jade pin, a few strands loosened by the long shift. Body: small and slight, standing very still so as not to shake the light. Clothing: a clean white silk junior disciple's robe with three crossed collars edged in ice blue, silver snowflake embroidery at the cuffs, one sleeve damp, a pale-blue sash with a white jade pendant, chalk dust on the hem. Hands and objects: the cold-light globe held at chest height in one hand, steady, its glow lighting her fingers from below. Power: tiny pale blue motes of earth-and-water qi swim in the globe's light and cling to her sleeve. Background: a stone tunnel receding under the seat with a ring of faint blue lights, and a stooped man with damp knees coming up out of a shaft, blurred. Light: cold blue-white spirit-light from the lamp, from below and the left, a soft silver rim light on her hair. Expression: a tired, watchful, careful look, eyes large and grave and mouth patient, a humble girl who sees everything in the damp and says nothing until she is sure.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder: a slight scholar in southern grey with a jade vessel at the waist and ink on her wrist.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder, faded like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, standing in a desert pass holding a small jade vessel in both hands and looking quietly at the viewer. Face: a slight, scholarly, calm face of about sixty; thoughtful dark eyes; a fine nose; a small composed mouth with a faint look of poetry in it; the silk cracked in fine lines and browned at the corners. Hair: black streaked with grey, in a scholar's knot with a plain jade pin and a thin silver crown. Body: slight and upright. Clothing: robes of southern grey silk in three crossed collars, a long pale gauze over-robe with wide sleeves embroidered at the borders with faint silver frost, a plain sash with a small jade vessel hung at the waist; ink on her right wrist. Hands and objects: a small jade vessel held in both hands, a piece of ice inside it that has not melted. Power: a faint pale shimmer of cold qi rises from the vessel like breath, drawn in soft brown wash. Background: a pale desert falling away to a far horizon where a white line of distant ice shines, rendered in soft brown wash like the rest of the silk. Light: a soft faded gold, as of old pigment, a thin pale rim light. Expression: a calm, patient, quietly ambitious look, eyes level and mouth composed, a scholar who has already seen the far ice and means to bring a piece of it home.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of a plum-blossom swordsman who rode out and did not return.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded like an old silk painting with the edges darkened: a plum-blossom swordsman who rode out and did not return stands looking at the viewer. Face: a lean, brave, honest face of about thirty-five; dark eyes; a straight nose; a firm mouth with a faint smile; a sword scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: black, tied up in a topknot with a white jade pin, a few loose strands at the temples. Body: lean and tall, upright, shoulders squared, one hand at his side as if the ride had not yet begun. Clothing: a plum-red silk sword robe with three crossed collars edged in pale blue, long wide sleeves embroidered at the cuffs with silver plum blossoms, a pale gauze over-robe, a plain frost-silk sash with a jade pendant, the red softened by age to a dusty rose. Hands and objects: a plum-blossom sword hanging at his side in its scabbard, the other hand resting easy. Power: a thin pink glow of sword qi along the scabbard, with a few faint plum petals drawn in brown wash drifting from it. Background: faint in brown wash, a ruined fortress wall under a smoky sky and a line of riders far off; the silk cracked and marked with a brown water-ring. Light: faded, warm and soft like old pigment, a gentle pale rim light. Expression: a steady, brave, honest look with a small, loyal, slightly rueful smile, a man looking at the viewer as if he already knows the ride will not bring him home.
